items.info: Center Pedestal. Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Deploys wing panels to increase drag and reduce airspeed or increase descent rate.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Commands the extension or retraction of the wing flaps and slats.
items.label: Flap Lever

items.info: Center Pedestal. Selects the engine ignition and start mode. Check it is in NORM before power-up.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Center Pedestal. Controls fuel flow and initiates the start or shutdown sequence for both engines.
items.label: Engine Masters

items.info: Center Pedestal. Both levers at idle before power-up.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Scans for and displays precipitation and storm activity ahead of the aircraft.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Check the gear lever is down before power-up.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connects batteries 1 and 2. Check that the voltage is above 25.5V before switching ON.
items.label: Battery 1+2

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connects ground electrical power to the aircraft networks when engines and APU are off.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the aircraft's navigation lights and tail logo for visibility.
items.label: Nav & Logo Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verifies the integrity of the APU fire detection and extinguishing system.
items.label: APU Fire Test

items.info: Overhead Panel. Starts the Auxiliary Power Unit to provide electrical and pneumatic power on the ground. Turn the APU Master ON, wait 3 seconds for the flap to open, then turn APU Start ON.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Supplies pressurized air from the APU for engine starting and air conditioning. Verify the PACK fault lights extinguish after it is turned on.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connects ground electrical power to the aircraft networks when engines and APU are off.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Supplies oxygen to the pilots' masks in case of cabin depressurization.
items.label: Crew Oxygen

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn IR1, IR2, and IR3 to NAV. Alignment takes about 8 minutes.
items.label: ADIRS

items.info: Overhead Panel. Controls all external aircraft lighting. Set Strobes to AUTO, Beacon OFF, Nav ON, and others as required.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Controls the Fasten Seatbelt and No Smoking signs in the cabin.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Arms the independent lighting system to illuminate evacuation paths if aircraft power is lost.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Supplies fuel under pressure from the tanks to the engines.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Tests the fire warning circuits and extinguishing systems for both engines.
items.label: Engine Fire Test

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verification of overhead switches. Scan from bottom to top, left to right, ensuring no white lights remain.
items.label: Overhead Panel

items.info: MCDU. Entering flight plan and performance data. Fill out INIT A, F-PLN, INIT B, and PERF pages before departure.
items.label: MCDU Preflight

items.info: Glareshield (EFIS panel). Set the departure airport QNH on the baro knob.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Provides visual guidance cues on the PFD to manually fly the programmed trajectory.
items.label: Flight Directors

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Sets target speed and heading. Both should show dashes to confirm they are in managed mode.
items.label: FCU SPD/HDG

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Set the initial climb altitude from your departure clearance.
items.label: FCU Altitude

items.info: Primary Flight Display. The Flight Mode Annunciator shows the autothrust and autopilot modes. With the flight directors on, check SRS (takeoff mode) and NAV in blue, armed.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Standby attitude, altitude, and airspeed — cross-check.
items.label: Standby Instruments

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Maximizes braking efficiency and prevents tire skidding during landing or a rejected takeoff.
items.label: Anti-Skid

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Displays hydraulic pressure for the wheel brakes. Ensure the accumulator pressure is in the green band.
items.label: Brake Pressure

items.info: Center Pedestal. Transmits aircraft identification to ATC. Set your squawk code and ALT RPTG ON. Leave in STBY until taxi.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Center Pedestal. Traffic Collision Avoidance System detects nearby aircraft and provides resolution advisories.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Center Pedestal. SET for engine start at the gate, released for pushback. Pushback is on the flyPad Ground page.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Cockpit. Verifies that the sliding cockpit windows are closed and securely latched.
items.label: Windows

items.info: Center Pedestal. Controls the locking mechanism for the reinforced cockpit door.
items.label: Cockpit Door

items.info: Overhead Panel. Starts the Auxiliary Power Unit to provide electrical and pneumatic power on the ground. Turn the APU Master ON, wait 3 seconds for the flap to open, then turn APU Start ON.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Supplies pressurized air from the APU for engine starting and air conditioning. Verify the PACK fault lights extinguish after it is turned on.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connects ground electrical power to the aircraft networks when engines and APU are off.
items.label: External Power

items.info: ECAM. Verifies all passenger and cargo doors are securely closed and locked prior to departure.
items.label: Doors

items.info: MCDU PERF page. Cross-check V1, VR, V2 and FLEX or TOGA thrust setting against calculated takeoff data before calling for start.
items.label: T/O Speeds & Thrust

items.info: Overhead Panel. Red flashing light indicating engines are running or about to start.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Exterior. Confirm ground crew has removed all gear pins, locks, and covers before pushback.
items.label: Gear Pins & Covers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Both levers must be at idle before engine start.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Turn to IGN/START before opening the engine masters. The ENG page appears on the lower ECAM.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Center Pedestal. Start engine 2 first. Watch N2, EGT and fuel flow until the engine is stable at idle.
items.label: Engine Master 2

items.info: Center Pedestal. Start engine 1 once engine 2 is stable. Watch the engine parameters until stable.
items.label: Engine Master 1

items.info: Center Pedestal. Return to NORM once both engines are stable at idle.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn OFF once both engines are running. The engine bleeds now supply the packs.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shuts the APU down after engine start. The engine generators now power the aircraft.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. Routes hot bleed air to the engine cowls to prevent ice accumulation.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Routes hot bleed air to the wing leading edges to prevent ice accumulation.
items.label: Wing Anti-Ice

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Set MAX for takeoff. If you reject the takeoff with the thrust levers at idle, full braking applies automatically.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Flap lever to 1. On the ground this gives CONF 1+F, shown on the upper ECAM. Match the flap setting on the MCDU PERF TAKEOFF page.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal. Arms spoilers to deploy automatically upon touchdown to reduce lift and increase drag.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: ECAM STS page. Verify no status messages remaining after engine start. Any active items must be addressed before taxi.
items.label: ECAM Status

items.info: Center Pedestal. Adjusts the rudder's resting position to counteract yawing forces.
items.label: Rudder Trim

items.info: Center Pedestal. Adjusts the horizontal stabilizer. Set this according to the calculated THS value from your PERF page.
items.label: Pitch Trim

items.info: Side Stick. Controls the aircraft's pitch and roll. Verify full and free movement on the ECAM F/CTL page.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Overhead Panel. Nose light to TAXI for taxi. It goes to T.O at lineup.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the area to the sides of the nose gear to aid in turning off the runway.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity flashing white lights at the wingtips used to increase visibility in flight and on the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set the squawk code and ALT RPTG ON. AUTO for taxi.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Center Pedestal. Release once you have taxi clearance and the ground crew is clear.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Rudder Pedals. Press the toe brakes gently as the aircraft starts to roll to confirm they work.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Air conditioning packs provide cabin pressurization and temperature control. Turn ON if they were previously set OFF for takeoff.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Routes hot bleed air to the engine cowls to prevent ice accumulation.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Primary interface for autopilot inputs. Verify speed, heading, and altitude show dashes for managed modes.
items.label: FCU Panel

items.info: Primary Flight Display. Expect SRS, NAV in blue (armed), and RWY if the runway has a localizer. Once thrust is set, the first column shows MAN FLX with the flex temperature, or MAN TOGA.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Displays a topographical map on the Navigation Display to aid in terrain clearance.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Confirm MAX is set before entering the runway.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Scans for and displays precipitation and storm activity ahead of the aircraft.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Center Pedestal. Activates the predictive windshear system on the weather radar to detect hazardous wind conditions.
items.label: PRED W/S

items.info: Center Pedestal. Selects the engine ignition mode. Use IGN/START if there is precipitation or icing conditions.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Center Pedestal. Arms spoilers to deploy automatically upon touchdown to reduce lift and increase drag.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Confirm CONF 1+F on the upper ECAM and that it matches the MCDU PERF TAKEOFF page.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal. Traffic Collision Avoidance System detects nearby aircraft and provides resolution advisories.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Center Pedestal. Tests aircraft configuration. Press T.O CONFIG and verify the ECAM memo reads TAKEOFF NO BLUE.
items.label: T.O Config

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity flashing white lights at the wingtips used to increase visibility in flight and on the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity forward-facing lights. Keep these ON when operating below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Nose light to T.O for the takeoff roll.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the area to the sides of the nose gear to aid in turning off the runway.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal. Push to the FLX/MCT detent for a reduced-thrust takeoff, or to TOGA for full thrust.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Sidestick. At VR, rotate smoothly at about 3° per second, then follow the flight director.
items.label: Rotate
Positive Climb
items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Raise the gear lever once the altimeter and vertical speed show a positive climb.
Glareshield (FCU). Engages the automated flight control system. Engage at your discretion after a positive climb is established.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Confirm the lever is up and the gear has retracted.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. At thrust reduction altitude, when LVR CLB flashes on the PFD, pull the levers back to the CL detent.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Primary Flight Display. With the thrust levers in CL, expect THR CLB, then CLB (managed) or OP CLB (selected), and NAV.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Center Pedestal. Controls trailing edge flaps. During climb, retract to Flaps 1 at F-speed, and Flaps 0 at S-speed.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal. Disarm the ground spoilers after takeoff by pushing the speed brake lever down.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Selects the engine ignition mode. Use IGN/START if there is precipitation or icing conditions.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. Air conditioning packs provide cabin pressurization and temperature control. Turn ON if they were previously set OFF for takeoff.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Once cleared, turn the altitude knob to your cruise level and push it to continue the managed climb.
items.label: FCU Altitude

items.info: Glareshield (EFIS panel). Push the baro knob for STD at the transition altitude.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity forward-facing lights. Keep these ON when operating below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Provides forward illumination during taxi and takeoff. Turn OFF after climbing above 10,000 feet.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Displays a topographical map on the Navigation Display to aid in terrain clearance.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Overhead Panel. Controls the Fasten Seatbelt and No Smoking signs in the cabin.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Primary Flight Display. At cruise level, expect MACH (or SPEED), ALT CRZ and NAV.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Overhead Panel. Controls and monitors the cabin altitude and pressure differential.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Overhead Panel. Prevents or removes ice buildup on critical aircraft surfaces and engine cowls.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: MCDU. The programmed route in the flight management system. Check your estimated fuel on board and flight plan progress.
items.label: Flight Plan

items.info: Navigation Display. The T/D arrow on the ND marks the calculated point to start descending.
items.label: Top of Descent

items.info: MCDU. Performance data for arrival. Check the ATIS for the active runway, wind, altimeter, and temperature.
items.label: Landing Info

items.info: MCDU. Load the arrival and approach on the F-PLN page, then enter QNH, temperature, wind and minimums in PERF APPR.
items.label: MCDU Approach

items.info: MCDU RAD NAV page. Check the ILS frequency and course for the approach you loaded, and enter them if they are missing.
items.label: ILS Frequency

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Sets the target altitude. Set your platform altitude or the last waypoint altitude before the runway, but do not push yet.
items.label: FCU Altitude

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Automatically applies wheel brakes on landing. Set to LO or MED based on your runway length and conditions.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: ECAM. Indicates the total amount of fuel on board.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Push the altitude selector to start a managed descent and monitor your path deviations.
items.label: Descent

items.info: Primary Flight Display. In a managed descent, expect THR IDLE, DES and NAV. A selected descent shows OP DES instead of DES.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Center Pedestal. Extend to steepen the descent if you are above the profile. Retract before selecting flaps.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Prevents or removes ice buildup on critical aircraft surfaces and engine cowls.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Center Pedestal. Selects the engine ignition mode. Use IGN/START if there is precipitation or icing conditions.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Glareshield (EFIS panel). Pull the baro knob and set the destination QNH passing the transition level.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Controls the Fasten Seatbelt and No Smoking signs in the cabin.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Displays a topographical map on the Navigation Display to aid in terrain clearance.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity forward-facing lights. Keep these ON when operating below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Nose light to T.O below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the area to the sides of the nose gear to aid in turning off the runway.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Glareshield (EFIS panel). Confirm the destination QNH is set on both sides.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Center Pedestal. Selects the engine ignition mode. Use IGN/START if there is precipitation or icing conditions.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: MCDU. Tunes the Instrument Landing System frequency. Cross-check this on the RAD NAV page.
items.label: ILS Frequency

items.info: MCDU PERF APPR page. BARO is the decision altitude for a standard approach; RADIO is the decision height for a low-visibility approach. The value shows on the PFD.
items.label: Minimums

items.info: MCDU PERF page. Activate the approach phase with the speed knob pushed for managed speed. The aircraft then slows to green dot, the green circle on the speed tape.
items.label: Approach Phase

items.info: Center Pedestal. Arms spoilers to deploy automatically upon touchdown to reduce lift and increase drag.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Displays ILS localizer and glideslope deviations. Turn ON for ILS approaches, but leave OFF for RNAV.
items.label: LS Mode

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Arms the approach modes: LOC and G/S in blue on the FMA for an ILS, or APP NAV and FINAL for an RNAV approach.
items.label: APPR

items.info: Center Pedestal. Select Flaps 1 at green dot speed, typically around 15 NM out. Wait for the speed tape to slow to green dot first.
items.label: Flaps 1

items.info: Center Pedestal. Secondary flap setting. Select this at S-speed, usually upon localizer intercept.
items.label: Flaps 2

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Lower the gear after Flaps 2, before 2,000 ft above the runway, and check three green lights.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Automatically applies wheel brakes on landing. Set to LO or MED based on your runway length and conditions.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Intermediate flap setting to increase lift and drag as you slow down on approach.
items.label: Flaps 3

items.info: Center Pedestal. Final landing configuration to provide maximum lift and drag for touchdown.
items.label: Flaps Full

items.info: ECAM upper display. LANDING memo should show no blue items — all landing configuration checks complete.
items.label: ECAM Memo

items.info: Glareshield (FCU), or the red button on the sidestick. Disconnect by minimums unless you are flying an autoland.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Sidestick. At about 20 ft, raise the nose gently to reduce the rate of descent. For an autoland, keep hands off until rollout.
items.label: Flare

items.info: Center Pedestal. Pull the thrust levers to IDLE during the flare.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Full reverse at touchdown, reverse idle at 70 knots, then forward idle by 25 knots.
items.label: Reverse Thrust

items.info: Rudder Pedals. Brake to taxi speed with the toe brakes, or let the autobrake do it if set. After an autoland, disconnect the autopilot before turning off the runway.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity flashing white lights at the wingtips used to increase visibility in flight and on the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Retract and switch OFF once clear of the runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Nose light to TAXI once clear of the runway.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the area to the sides of the nose gear to aid in turning off the runway.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Prevents or removes ice buildup on critical aircraft surfaces and engine cowls.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Starts the Auxiliary Power Unit to provide electrical and pneumatic power on the ground. Turn the APU Master ON, wait 3 seconds for the flap to open, then turn APU Start ON.
items.label: APU

items.info: Glareshield (FCU). Displays ILS localizer and glideslope deviations. Turn ON for ILS approaches, but leave OFF for RNAV.
items.label: LS Mode

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Displays a topographical map on the Navigation Display to aid in terrain clearance.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Main Instrument Panel. Press the lit autobrake button, or the brake pedals, to disengage it below 20 knots.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Push the speed brake lever down to retract and disarm the ground spoilers once off the runway.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retract flaps and slats fully once clear of the runway.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal. Scans for and displays precipitation and storm activity ahead of the aircraft.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Center Pedestal. Activates the predictive windshear system on the weather radar to detect hazardous wind conditions.
items.label: PRED W/S

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set to STBY once clear of the runway.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Center Pedestal. Traffic Collision Avoidance System detects nearby aircraft and provides resolution advisories.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Center Pedestal. Prevents the aircraft from rolling while parked.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the area to the sides of the nose gear to aid in turning off the runway.
items.label: RWY Turnoff Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn OFF once parked.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Supplies air to the packs from the APU once the engines are shut down.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Center Pedestal. Controls fuel flow and initiates the start or shutdown sequence for both engines.
items.label: Engine Masters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Controls the Fasten Seatbelt and No Smoking signs in the cabin.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Red flashing light indicating engines are running or about to start.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Overhead Panel. Prevents or removes ice buildup on critical aircraft surfaces and engine cowls.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Supplies fuel under pressure from the tanks to the engines.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Center Pedestal. Release once the ground crew has the chocks in place.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Supplies oxygen to the pilots' masks in case of cabin depressurization.
items.label: Crew Oxygen

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn IR 1, 2 and 3 to OFF.
items.label: ADIRS

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn all exterior lights OFF, including Nav & Logo.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn OFF before the APU master.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shuts the APU down. Wait for the APU to stop before switching the batteries OFF.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. Arms the independent lighting system to illuminate evacuation paths if aircraft power is lost.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn OFF Battery 1 and 2 to fully de-power the aircraft.
items.label: Batteries

description: An advanced wide-body engineered for effortless global travel and Airspace cabin comfort.
